newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JUNE BUILDING PERMITS RISE 12 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JUNE BUILDING PERMITS RISE 12 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 12 percent year-on-year in June to over three million cubic metres, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Friday.
In January-June, building permits granted rose 24 percent year-on-year to 16.4 million cubic metres.
Building permits for housing constructions rose 16 percent in the first half of 1996.
The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose in almost all types of buildings in January-June, SF said.
